Read PNG headers only to verify dimensions and the 2:3 ratio: native and usage views have zero ratio deviation, thumbnails have approximately 0.156% deviation due to integer width rounding, within 1%. Scores are separate integer judgments without a total or target. Closest-pair score uses the diversity distinction scale, where 1 is near-repeat and 5 is strongly distinct. No claim of authorship or physical printing performance is made.
